Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

fastEukaryotyping 0.1.0

  • Initial package skeleton.
  • Pure-R reference implementation of euk_heuristic_distance_r().
  • C++17/RcppParallel implementation of euk_heuristic_distance_impl().
  • Added impute_data flag to euk_heuristic_distance() and reference implementation.
  • Two-pass missing-locus imputation ported from Joel-Barratt/Eukaryotyping.
  • euk_heuristic_distance() matches the original Barratt heuristic output on the filtered 68-sample HDS fixture (barratt_expected.rds) to within 1e-10.
  • Pure-R reference euk_bayesian_distance_r() porting Plucinski’s euk_bayesian_fulldataset_V2.r, including epsilon fallbacks and the multiset/unique-overlap pair semantics of the original.
  • C++17/RcppParallel implementation euk_bayesian_distance_impl().
  • euk_bayesian_distance() matches the original script output on the same 68-sample fixture to within 1e-10 (R and C++ backends).
  • euk_ensemble_distance(): rank-mapped mean of the heuristic and Bayesian matrices, per the original ensemble workflow.
  • Added inst/COPYRIGHTS and cran-comments.md; R CMD check --as-cran reports 0 errors, 0 warnings and 2 expected notes (new submission, system compiler flag).
  • Original authors moved out of Authors@R pending their consent; attribution retained in inst/COPYRIGHTS and the method citation.

Migration: _cpp suffix removed, _r functions deprecated

  • Internal C++ functions renamed from .euk_*_distance_cpp to .euk_*_distance_impl (the _cpp suffix is no longer part of the release API).
  • use_r = FALSE is now the default; the C++ backend is the primary implementation path. use_r = TRUE emits a deprecation warning.
  • Pure-R reference functions (euk_heuristic_distance_r, euk_bayesian_distance_r) are marked deprecated and emit a deprecation warning when called. They remain available for cross-validation and development. euk_ensemble_distance_r is NOT deprecated: it is the internal engine behind euk_ensemble_distance (no C++ equivalent).

Ensemble and Bayesian edge-case fixes (algorithm-page review)

  • euk_ensemble_distance() gains method: "original" (default) reproduces the run.r distribution-mapping ensemble verbatim (2-B, min-max normalisation, sorted Bayesian values mapped onto heuristic ranks, random tie breaking controllable via seed). "rank" is a direction-consistent fractional-rank mean that ranks 2 - D_bayesian so both components are divergence-oriented. The previous undirected rank mean (which cancelled anti-correlated inputs to ~0.5) is replaced.
  • Bayesian C++ backend now returns 1.0 (uniform posterior) for pairs with no comparable locus, matching the R and original-script convention; previously it returned NA (diagonal included).
  • New tests cover run.r ensemble equivalence, seed determinism, rank-direction ordering, and no-comparable-locus backend parity.

CRAN and documentation

  • Added _pkgdown.yml for pkgdown site generation.
  • Added LICENSE (GPL >= 3).
  • Added inst/CITATION for citation("fasteukaryotyping").
  • Added vignettes: introduction.Rmd (package overview and methods) and mlst-typing-workflow.Rmd (end-to-end analysis workflow).
  • Updated man/ Rd files via roxygen2.
  • R CMD check: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 1 note (Rd braces only).
  • 16 tests pass, covering fixture equivalence, random-data parity between R and C++, symmetry, and range validation.
